annotation.title_clean: Part 12: Tools, Machinery and Equipment (BC Occupational Health and Safety Regulation)
annotation.title_en: Part 12: Tools, Machinery and Equipment (BC Occupational Health and Safety Regulation)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: WorkSafeBC (Workers' Compensation Board of British Columbia)
annotation.summary_en: Part 12 of British Columbia's Occupational Health and Safety Regulation sets binding safeguarding and safe-use rules for machinery and tools. Its only robotics provision, s. 12.83, requires industrial robots and robot systems to meet CSA Z434-94 or ANSI/RIA R15.06-1992 for installation, safeguarding, maintenance, programming and training.
key_provisions_or_claims: Employers must fit machinery with safeguards against power transmission parts, points of operation and ejected material (s. 12.2).
Industrial robots must be installed, safeguarded, maintained, tested, programmed and operated per CSA Z434-94 or ANSI/RIA R15.06-1992, including worker training (s. 12.83).
Remote controls for mobile equipment need a fail-safe stop mechanism (s. 12.11(3)).
Unsafe equipment must be removed from service until made safe (s. 12.10).
